scheme.name: Semantic Versioning (Website Releases)
scheme.summary: Website versions follow MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH and track public interface, documentation, publication platform, and infrastructure releases on spheredesci.org.
scheme.integrity_note: The website version number tracks site releases only. It is independent of the registered Protocol LOC-1 preregistration on OSF and the archived whitepaper on Zenodo, and does not indicate completed measurements or research results.

releases.title: Site versioning & chronological release log
releases.summary: Introduces an explicit semantic version number for spheredesci.org and a structured, chronological release log accessible across the site.

changes.text: Added the dedicated Site Version & Release Changelog page with a current-version summary, chronological release timeline, sort order toggle, and category filters.
Added a Site Releases section to the homepage highlighting the live site version number and latest chronological updates, plus a wayfinder bar shortcut.
Added a site-wide version badge in the footer and a hand-drawn changelog emblem in the Governance navigation menu, built from a single data/changelog.json source of truth.

releases.title: Four-section navigation, hand-drawn icons & live Control Room routing
releases.summary: Reorganized site-wide navigation into four illustrated pillars, introduced chaptered homepage wayfinding, and routed lab.spheredesci.org to the live educational simulator.

changes.text: Reorganized desktop and mobile navigation into four top-level pillars (Experiment, Library, Governance, and Community) backed by 29 custom hand-drawn scientific-etching SVG icons.
Restructured the homepage into numbered chapters with a sticky horizontal wayfinder bar and an Explore by section directory.
Routed lab.spheredesci.org directly to the live SPHEREVL Control Room dashboard on Vercel (educational simulation; not physical measurements).

releases.title: Homepage metrology visualizations & API hardening
releases.summary: Added illustrative metrology visualizations to the homepage and hardened worker endpoints and HTML build verification.

changes.text: Refined the homepage layout with illustrative metrology visualizations and improved section pacing.
Hardened the aggregate analytics and community vote remix endpoints, resolved incomplete-sanitization code scanning alerts, and validated breadcrumb URLs by origin.
Updated the build-time HTML linter to handle browser-tolerated closing tags cleanly across generated and hand-written pages.

releases.title: CodeQL analysis, Q-factor guide & metrology research notes
releases.summary: Added automated CodeQL security scanning, aligned analysis wording strictly with the registered OSF plan, and published new research and educational explainers.

changes.text: Enabled automated CodeQL static analysis for worker/ and tools/, and aligned the homepage preregistered-analysis wording with the registered Protocol LOC-1 record on OSF.
Published the Q factor (quality factor) educational explainer in the Learn library.
Added proposal-stage research notes on site-environment record-and-replay, blind analysis position labels, and copper's temperature coefficient.
Added self-referencing hreflang annotations to all indexable pages, IndexNow key verification, and Lighthouse SEO exemptions for noindex discovery pages.

releases.title: Mobile video playback, weekly research essays & LLC entity metadata
releases.summary: Enabled reliable mobile video playback with byte-range delivery, expanded Learn explainers, and published three research essays.

changes.text: Re-encoded the homepage explainer video for phone hardware decoding and added HTTP byte-range support for iOS Safari and Android browsers.
Published weekly research notes on loop-induced Lorentz violation, NIST high-frequency acoustic resonators, and open-science funding infrastructure.
Expanded twelve /learn/ guides to 1,200+ words each and added SPHERE Research, LLC entity metadata across the site.

releases.title: Registered Protocol LOC-1, Zenodo whitepaper & MDX publication platform
releases.summary: Marked the live OSF preregistration of Protocol LOC-1, Zenodo whitepaper archival, and launch of the static MDX scientific publishing platform.

changes.text: Published permanent links and site-wide footer badges for the live OSF Protocol LOC-1 preregistration and archived Zenodo whitepaper (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23583932).

Launched the build-time MDX publication platform generating Research, Knowledge Base, Glossary, Search, Author, Category, Tag, and RSS feeds with citation linking and privacy-preserving aggregate analytics.
Added print-to-PDF whitepaper styling, academic indexing metadata, HTML/SEO build lint checks, and standardized the full project name to Spatial Positioning Harmonic Empirical Resonance Experiment.

releases.title: Community votes, resonance guides & hollow copper sphere reference
releases.summary: Launched informal community identity polls, five resonance guides, a proposed A/B/A verification protocol, and a hollow copper sphere reference page.

changes.text: Launched Community Votes backed by Cloudflare D1, opening with 109 logo concepts and an SVG remix lab (informal public-identity polls, not research).
Added five resonance guides in Learn, the proposed A/B/A excitation-off verification protocol, and the record-and-replay resonance proposal.
Added the provisional hollow copper sphere reference page covering shell geometry, purity, and planning ranges, plus the separate /projects/ section.

releases.title: Plain-language homepage, Learn section & funding phases
releases.summary: Introduced a plain-language introduction video and overview, three-phase budget structure, and twelve foundational Learn explainers.

changes.text: Added the plain-language homepage opening, captioned introduction video with full transcript, and three-phase planning budget summary.
Launched the Learn section with twelve plain-language explainers on DeSci, open science, preregistration, null results, resonance, vibrometry, blinding, and simulation.

releases.title: SPHEREVL visual lab, synchronized-measurement proposals & community tools
releases.summary: Overhauled the SPHEREVL visual lab overview, added eight synchronized-measurement proposal pages, and launched community directory and newsletter tools.

changes.text: Rebuilt the /vl/ visual lab page with Control Room simulator screenshots, repository history snapshot, stated limitations, and educational-simulation notices.
Published eight synchronized-measurement proposal pages including the four-object protocol draft, frequency error budget, Earth-motion analyses, and hardware checklist.
Added Links & Profiles, opt-in Directory, Calendar with downloadable .ics feed, Newsletter archive (Issue 1), and proposal-stage Careers application pages.

releases.title: Public research foundation
releases.summary: Established the pre-launch public research website with transparent scope, charter, FAQ, and update log.

changes.text: Published the Research Charter, About overview, FAQ, Collaborate page, initial LOC-1 protocol summary, budget transparency page, and Project Updates log.
Removed placeholder funding totals, wallet counts, and token-sale wording to distinguish hypotheses from established findings.
